title: Applying a lifted action
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, $c$ a configuration of the four-tape interpreter on $x$, $clock$ a Boolean word, and $a$ an action of that interpreter. Applying the six-tape lift of $a$ to the six-tape lift of $c$ with clock word $clock$ gives exactly the lift of the configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $c$, with the same clock word.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a four-tape interpreter configuration on $x$
replaced:
Applying the six-tape lift of a four-tape interpreter action to the six-tape
lift of a four-tape configuration (with any clock word) equals the lift of the
configuration obtained by applying the action: the clock word is unchanged and
any emission is captured on the buffer lane, including an emission on the
action's halting transition.
